files.title: File:Old Harmar Post Office, Gilman Avenue, Harmar, Marietta, OH - 54306598527.jpg
files.author: w_lemay
files.caption: Built in 1864, this Folk Victorian-style building was built for Lydia Young to serve as a notary shop, and also served as the Harmar Post Office until 1885.  The building is simple two story structure, with a noticeable lean, one-over-one double-hung windows, and a wooden clapboard-clad exterior.  The building is a contributing structure in the Harmar Historic District, listed on the National Register of Historic Places in 1974, and expanded to its present size in 1993.
